verdict.rationale: Base44 documents several built-in AI assistants that take on delegated work. The editor AI updates code, styles and components from natural-language requests. Superagents research and complete web tasks, run scheduled or triggered workflows, and take meeting notes and email them. There is also a testing agent that runs browser tests. Community users confirm that delegating app building to the built-in AI works in practice. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Superagent task-delegation features (browser control, workflows, meeting notes) beyond vendor docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe what you want in natural language, and AI updates code, styles, and components for you.
Your Superagent can research, look things up, and complete tasks on the web for you.
A workflow runs on a schedule or when a trigger happens, such as activity in a connected tool.
It records the meeting, writes up the notes and action items, saves them to its notes library, and emails them to you when the meeting ends.
The testing agent runs browser-based tests on your app's key flows
I quickly built a retirement calculator, two prompts and deploy.
